quest.description: A wraith of uncommon will has bound lesser shades to its service and styles itself a tyrant. Its lair riddles the hill like a wasp nest — find the throne cavern and cut the tyrant down.

4,2.description: A jagged fissure splits the hillside, breathing cold air that smells of storm and old stone. Every shadow inside seems to lean toward you.

3,2.description: A descending throat of rock, its walls sheathed in pale frost that does not melt.

3,3.description: A den of gnawed bones and rag nests, abandoned by whatever lived here before the shades came.

3,1.description: A side gallery littered with shattered stone. The floor sags ominously toward its center.

2,2.description: A vaulted nexus where five tunnels once met; two have collapsed. Whispers circle the dome overhead.

2,1.description: A worm-bored passage, slick and glistening.

2,0.description: A hollow chamber where the frost thickens into feathered patterns on every surface.

1,0.description: A plundered burial nook. What the tyrant's servants could not use, they left scattered.

2,3.description: A gallery of scratched tally-marks, thousands upon thousands, gouged into the stone.

2,4.description: The remains of a camp: split packs, a cold fire ring, and no sign of the travelers themselves.

1,4.description: A crevice vault where the tyrant hoards what it cannot touch. Metal gleams beneath fallen scree.

1,2.description: A warded threshold before the throne cavern. Sigils of binding flicker faintly across the floor.

0,2.description: The throne cavern. Upon a seat of fused bone and ice sits the Wraith Tyrant, crowned in frost-fire.

characters.name: Bound Shadow
characters.description: A ragged scrap of living darkness dragging at an unseen chain, compelled to hold this den.

characters.name: Frost Shadow
characters.description: A shade rimed in pale frost. Cold pours off it in waves; the air cracks quietly wherever it drifts.

characters.name: Watcher Shadow
characters.description: A tall stain of darkness standing over the ruined camp, a sentry that has forgotten what it guards.

characters.name: Wraith Tyrant
characters.description: A towering shade crowned in frost-fire, its will a chain about every lesser wraith in the lair.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A small vial of red liquid that restores health.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A traveler's potion, dropped in flight and never recovered.

items.name: Spectral Edge
items.description: A sword-shaped absence in the air, cold to hold and colder to receive.

objective.description: Slay the Wraith Tyrant on its throne of bone and ice.
